name: spendveto-wasm-policy
description: SpendVeto's policy-decision core, compiled to a portable WebAssembly module — the same rules as client/policy.js's checkPolicy, with all state (freezes, ledger spend, delegation tree, resolved payees) supplied by the host instead of fetched live, so the module itself does zero I/O and runs identically offline, in a browser, or at the edge.

scripts.asbuild:debug: asc assembly/index.ts --target debug --outFile build/debug.wasm --textFile build/debug.wat --sourceMap --debug --runtime incremental --exportRuntime
scripts.asbuild:release: asc assembly/index.ts --target release --outFile build/release.wasm --textFile build/release.wat --optimize --runtime incremental --exportRuntime --noAssert
scripts.asbuild: npm run asbuild:debug && npm run asbuild:release
